detaileddescription.para: For SD, this function checks whether the card is present.

listitem.para: STA_NOINIT if the drive is not initialized.
STA_NODISK if there is no medium in the drive.
STA_PROTECT if the drive is write protected.

simplesect.para: If the card detect signal is not connected, this function cannot check whether the card is present.

detaileddescription.para: For SD, this function initializes the host controller and the card. This function also selects additional settings such as bus width, speed, and block size.

simplesect.para:
Drive status. A value of 0 or STA_PROTECT alone indicates successful initialization. The status is a bitwise OR of the following flags.
STA_NODISK if the disk is not present.
STA_NOINIT if the drive is not initialized.
STA_PROTECT if the drive is write protected.

briefdescription.para: Implements the glue layer between the file system and the driver.

detaileddescription.para: Description related to the SD driver: To use the file system with SD, select xilffs in the Software Development Kit (SDK) when creating a board support package (BSP). In SDK, set "fs_interface" to 1 to select the SD interface. You can currently use this glue layer with only one SD controller enabled. To use an embedded MultiMediaCard (eMMC), set "Enable MMC" to 1 in SDK. Otherwise, the glue layer uses SD by default.

Description: This glue layer initializes the host controller and SD card in disk_initialize. If the SD card supports them, it enables 4-bit mode and high speed mode. The default block size is 512 bytes. The disk_read and disk_write functions read and write files using Advanced DMA version 2 (ADMA2) in polled mode. The file system can read from and write to an SD card that is already formatted as FATFS.
